meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 收到你在 cmem.ai 的连接凭据(同步令牌、用户ID、SyncHub 地址)后,把它写进 Cowork 插件设置,让它能保存和调用记忆。若本机还有本地 claude-mem,也会写入一份到本地设置。令牌不会在对话中回显。
howto.when: 当你说出 'set up claude-mem'、'pair claude-mem'、'connect cmem' 等要求,或直接给出 cmem.ai Connect 的连接值(同步令牌、用户ID、SyncHub 地址)时。

say.note: 我会请你提供 cmem.ai 的三个连接值。

say.text: 把我的 cmem 同步令牌配到 Cowork 插件里
say.note: 我会把令牌写入插件配置,并跑状态检查。
如果你贴上 Connect 信息,我会自动提取三个值。

howto.what_en: Configures the Cowork plugin with the user's cmem.ai Connect credentials (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) so its hooks can capture and inject memory. If a local ~/.claude-mem exists, writes the same values there too. Never echoes the token.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to 'set up claude-mem', 'pair claude-mem', 'connect cmem', etc., or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL).

say_en.note: I'll ask for the three cmem.ai connection values.

say_en.text: Add my cmem sync token to the Cowork plugin
say_en.note: I'll write it into the plugin config and run a status check.

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync in Cowork
say_en.note: If you paste the Connect blurb, I'll get the three values.
